func (c *Client) compute() (core.ComputeClient, error) {
	client, err := c.factory.Compute()
	c.pin(&client.BaseClient)
	return client, err
}

func (c *Client) network() (core.VirtualNetworkClient, error) {
	client, err := c.factory.Network()
	c.pin(&client.BaseClient)
	return client, err
}

	c.pin(&client.BaseClient)
	return client, err
}
